stats: The K-wing assault starfighter was produced by Koensayr Manufacturing, the same company responsible for producing the venerable Y-wing. Like many other New Republic starfighters, the K-wing was designed to excel in a specific primary role in combat while retaining the flexibility to serve secondary functions if needed.

K-wings were first deployed in combat by the New Republic during the Yevethan crisis. Throughout their service years, they were generally deployed in outsize squadrons, with three flights of six bombers a piece.

For the K-4m Security droid nicknamed "Mike", existence began as it did for most every droid in creation, boring. After years of being owned by several ungrateful, bags of bones, Mike was thankful to be stolen by an individual that at appeared to be exciting. Freed "Mike" was able to satisfy his desires to explore and answer questions about his own existence.
Find the truth of what this all really is for...

Built into the hands, feet, and knees of the suit, these “gecko-like” pads give +2D to climbing rolls.

The suit has breathing filters which remove most hazardous molecules as well as an internal air supply which can last for two hours. It is also temperature controlled, enabling the user to operate comfortably in temperatures ranging from -25 to 100 degrees Celsius.

Thermographic, infrared and low-light sensors give the wearer +2D to sight-based Perception checks in low-light conditions. Advanced hearing and sound filtration systems give a +1D to hearing-based Perception checks and protect the wearer from hearing damage due to loud noises.
Built into the face mask, these add +2D to Perception or search rolls for objects 100 to 500 meters away.

The suit features a built-in comlink system which enables the wearer to communicate with other members of his squad, though it can be adjusted to other frequencies. An external speaker is also built into the face mask.
Hardwired programming prevents this unit from being reprogrammed by an unauthorized person. Such attempts will result in circuitry overload and burnout.

Kaethar's bodies are laced with lodestone which allows them to attract or repel any light, metal object within 5 meters. The object moves at a slow pace, so it can not be used to attack. This ability may not be used on moving objects and can be used to stick to any metal surface.

Magblade: The ability to use a magblade to attack (see below) Difficulty based on range. Non-Kaethar may NOT learn this skill Magblade parry: The ability to use a magblade to parry in a melee (see below). Non-Kaethar may not learn this skill.
Kaethar are known for being excellent miners and metalworkers. Their metal trade makes them key targets for pirates.
The empire has agreed not to enslave the Kaethar because of their valuable metal trade. Kaethar who leave their homeworld are usually distrusted by most imperial authorities.

The Kaethar are best known for their unique magnetic field. They are the only known race which possesses this ability. Kaethar bodies are laced with lodestone which allows the Kaethar to manipulate a small magnetic field which is emitted from his body. The individual Kaethar can control when this magnetic field is in effect and in effect can "turn it off" when desired.
